correctness.rationale: Enumerate ternary squarefree prefixes to length 13 by rejecting newly formed suffix squares; factor closure guarantees exhaustive 342 words. Independently for every deletion of each word scan all square factors and require that all eleven interior deletions make a square: exactly 30 irreducible words. Radius max over deletions of minimum square period splits 18 at 3 and 12 at 6; quotient each by all 6 letter permutations and reversal gives orbit representatives 0102012101202 (12,3), 0102012102010 (6,3), 0102120102012 (12,6). Every last-orbit word has one unique period-6 deletion site; the displayed 11th deletion produces (010212)^2, with no smaller square period. Full finite word enumeration is exhaustive and proves this NATURAL length-13 result, not a general n claim.

evidence: Harju length spectrum includes all n>=13 and reports three orbits at n=13; no general theorem there forces which deletion positions require period 6.
